_comment: node-cron schedules + messaging windows. Cron uses 5-field syntax (minute hour day month weekday). Times run in server local time — keep the VPS timezone set to the clinic timezone.

followups._comment: Post-visit follow-up message asking how the patient is doing.

reengagement._comment: Win-back messages for clients with no visit in N days. Edit windowsDays to change the 30/60/90-day ladder.

digest._comment: Weekly owner digest (counts + flags). Consumed by src/services/digest.js.
